name: hcapp_setChatRoomParticipation
description: Sets how the calling hasher participates in ONE global chat room, from their settings console (James, 2026-09-14): 0 participate with push notifications (the default — no row means 0), 1 participate with badges only (silent push), 2 do not participate (the room is not listed and nothing is pushed). Stored on HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts.ParticipationState, the existing per-hasher per-room row, keyed (UserId, EventId NULL, KennelId NULL, ThreadId NULL, MessageType = @roomType); MERGE so a room never opened can still be configured, with LastSequenceCount 0 so the unread count stays honest. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 107, @param NULL). Permission gate: HC6.UserMayEnterChatRoom — the same gate as reading and sending, so this cannot be used to probe which rooms exist. hcapp_sendRoomMessage reads the state for its push audience (0 → visible, 1 → silent, 2 → none). Write SP: standard success envelope. Since 2026-10-13 its MERGE into HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts holds HOLDLOCK: the table has no unique key on (UserId, EventId, KennelId, ThreadId, MessageType), and two concurrent MERGEs could each insert a row.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret; @param NULL). Default NULL.

parameters.name: roomType
parameters.description: The room (HC6.ChatRoomCatalog().RoomType). Required; NULL is refused. Must be a room the caller may enter.

parameters.name: participationState
parameters.description: 0 participate with push · 1 participate, badges only · 2 opt out. Required; NULL or any other value is refused.

rowsets.description: Auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): the error detail is returned alone and the SP returns.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Every other outcome. Success = 1 after the commit. Success = 0 with ErrorMessage (and an HC.ErrorLog row) when @roomType is NULL or @participationState not in (0,1,2) — 'That setting could not be saved.'; when the caller may not enter the room — 'That chat room is for the hashers who hold its role.'; or from the CATCH (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; a user-facing sentence, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH, otherwise.

sideEffects: MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts on (UserId, EventId IS NULL, KennelId IS NULL, ThreadId IS NULL, MessageType = @roomType): UPDATE ParticipationState, or INSERT (UserId, EventId NULL, KennelId NULL, MessageType, LastSequenceCount 0, ParticipationState).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on every refused path and in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: Lines 22–23 say 'Nothing pushes for a room yet, so 0 and 1 behave identically today'. Room push shipped 2026-09-18 (hcapp_sendRoomMessage rowsets 2–3 split on exactly this value), so the two states now differ as designed. Documentation only — the code is right.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
